data.one_liner: Convert between MIME types and file extensions and detect file types from base64 data.
data.what_it_does: Provides bidirectional conversion between MIME types and file extensions with wildcard support. It also detects file extensions and MIME types from base64-encoded binary data using magic bytes and container inspection.
use_when: You need to resolve file extensions to MIME types or vice versa.
You need to determine a file type from base64 string data or data URIs.
You want wildcard lookups for broad file categories like image/*.
avoid_when: You need direct file system path manipulation utilities.
You are reading files directly from disk streams instead of handling strings/base64.
strengths: Comprehensive database of MIME types and over 400 file signatures.
Supports wildcards for category-based extension queries.
Zero external dependencies except the Flutter SDK.
weaknesses: Limited to string and base64 inputs rather than direct binary stream parsing.
